researched.description: Enterprise conversational and agentic AI platform sold across banking, insurance, retail, healthcare and higher education
researched.notes: Horizontal enterprise AI agent platform; higher education is one named vertical among many. HQ not stated anywhere on the site (about and contact pages give no address).

researched.description: Treasury, payments and liquidity management SaaS for corporate CFOs and treasurers
researched.notes: Horizontal corporate treasury platform; named customers are private enterprises (Spotify, HelloFresh, Baxter). Site, contact and privacy pages give no HQ address and no founding year, so both omitted.

researched.description: Financial planning, cost accounting and decision-support analytics for health systems, universities and banks
researched.notes: Primary market is health systems, with higher education and financial institutions as secondary verticals - a multi-industry product rather than a government-specific one, so flagged for owner review. Founding year not stated on site.

researched.description: Pet licensing, registration and lost-pet reunification platform for municipal animal services departments
researched.notes: Municipal-facing site is at partnerships.docupet.com; docupet.com is the pet-owner front end. Founded in Kingston, Ontario in 2012, added a New York office in 2018.

researched.description: Animal shelter and animal control management software tracking intakes, outcomes, licensing and donations for municipal shelters
researched.notes: Operated by Pet Loyalty Inc (petloyalty.co), which also owns Adopets; HQ address taken from the ShelterBuddy privacy notice. Founding year not published.

researched.description: Plan-It capital improvement planning and budgeting software for cities, counties, utilities, school districts and park districts
researched.notes: Product is branded Plan-It; HQ read from the site's structured-data postal address. Site claims 25+ years in CIP but gives no founding year.

researched.description: Strategic planning and performance management software for local governments, public agencies and other publicly funded organizations
researched.notes: Founding year not stated on the about page.

researched.description: Online, IVR and in-person payment processing for government agencies collecting property taxes, utility bills and court fees
researched.notes: Legal entity is Convenient Payments dba IntelliPay. Also sells to medical, nonprofit and property management, but the government page is the deepest vertical and claims two decades serving state governments. Founding year omitted: site copyright reads 2011 but the government page claims 20+ years, so the two conflict.

researched.description: Tax, property and revenue administration software for state and local government revenue agencies
researched.notes: Sells both the Government Premier platform and implementation consulting; the product line is the core offering. Site says 'nearly three decades' but names no founding year.

researched.description: enQuesta customer information and billing system for municipal electric, gas, water and wastewater utilities
researched.notes: Site claims 50 years of utility expertise but states no founding year.

researched.description: Human capital management platform covering HR, payroll, workforce management and talent for enterprises across all industries
researched.notes: Horizontal HCM (formerly Ceridian); public sector is one of six named industries alongside retail, manufacturing, financial services and sports. No HQ or founding year published on the site's company or contact pages.

researched.description: School district financial management, school nutrition and student data software for K-12 districts
researched.notes: A division of Harris Computer (Constellation Software); the locations page lists the Harris Computer Systems HQ in Ottawa with US offices in Easley SC, Mobile AL, Parsons KS, Pittsburgh PA and elsewhere. Product lines include AptaFund, NextGen, WinCap, eTrition, MealTime and EZSchoolPay. No founding year given.

researched.description: Digital menus, signage, e-ink food labels and mobile ordering for K-12 school nutrition and campus dining programs
researched.notes: Also sells to corporate dining and healthcare foodservice, but K-12 and higher education are the core markets. HQ address taken from the privacy policy (1550 Wewatta St, Denver).

researched.description: Online oversize/overweight, right-of-way and towing permit system for cities, villages, counties and road commissions
researched.notes: Site is a JavaScript app that returns almost no text to a plain fetch; content read via a rendered browser session. Free to the local agency, with carriers paying for permits. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Legal case management, document and AI drafting platform for law firms, in-house counsel and government legal offices
researched.notes: Primary buyer is private law firms; state and federal government legal departments (prosecutors, public defenders, attorneys general) are a named but secondary segment, so flagged for owner review. HQ from the privacy policy. Founding year not stated on the site.

researched.description: Community Health Record and care coordination software linking aging networks, FQHCs and state and county health and social services agencies
researched.notes: Formerly Care Coordination Systems, rebranded to CCS Health in 2023. No HQ address published on the site or its contact pages.

researched.description: Case management software for community supervision, pretrial services and specialty courts used by probation departments
researched.notes: Site claims 30 years and 378 departments but states no founding year.

researched.description: Lone-worker safety app, wearable panic button and alert monitoring service for organizations with mobile and field staff
researched.notes: Named industries mix public (social services, probation and parole, utilities) with private (mining, home builders, property management), so it reads as a cross-industry worker-safety product rather than a govtech one. No founding year published.

researched.description: Electronic monitoring devices and community supervision software for parole, probation and pretrial agencies
researched.notes: An Aventiv Technologies company (parent of Securus Technologies and JPay); HQ ZIP 75007 taken from the site's structured data. Offering is device plus platform, not software alone. No founding year published.

researched.description: AI decision-support and process optimization software for industrial operators, including a smart water offering for water and wastewater systems
researched.notes: Could not load calejo.ai from this environment - the origin refused every direct request and a proxy attempt hit a Cloudflare challenge, so all detail comes from indexed search snippets of the site. The registered entity appears to be Calejo Hybrid Intelligence AB (Sweden), whose flagship is Calejo Optimize for smart industries with Calejo Smart Water as a water vertical; I could not confirm that the exhibitor name 'Calejo Water Intelligence' is that same entity, and could not confirm HQ city or founding year. Worth a second look.

researched.description: Field work order and asset management software for local governments and utilities running smart meter and infrastructure projects
researched.notes: Heavy focus on AMI/smart meter deployment programs for gas, water and power utilities. No founding year published.

researched.description: Cloud environmental data management, EHS compliance and ESG reporting software for regulated enterprises and water utilities
researched.notes: Real product company, but the buyer set is any environmentally regulated enterprise - chemical manufacturers and industrials alongside water utilities - so it is not government-specific. Site says 'nearly 30 years' without a founding year.

researched.description: Mobile field service and workforce management software for municipal water, gas, electric, fiber and sanitation utilities
researched.notes: Name collision resolved: this is not ServiceLink the mortgage/title services firm (svclnk.com). The given URL service-link.us 301-redirects to servicelinksoftware.com, which is the canonical site. Site claims 30 years of industry experience but no founding year.

researched.description: Physics-informed AI forecasting of water supply, quality and drought risk for water utilities and infrastructure operators
researched.notes: Also markets to corporate water users and investors on supply-chain and disclosure risk, which pulls it partly outside the public-sector buyer; utilities are the first named audience. Site is a JS app read via a rendered browser session; no about page, HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Records digitization, preservation and archival supply services for county clerks, courts and assessors
researched.notes: Judgment call: they do ship a software platform (Kleio, AI document intelligence), but the solutions pages present preservation, digitization and archival products - binders, boxes, plat cabinets, shelving - as the core, staffed by preservationists and archivists. Reads as a services firm with a software layer, not a product company. No founding year published.

researched.description: Online workforce skills training and career services platform for state workforce agencies and local workforce development boards
researched.notes: Legal entity is NY Wired for Education dba Metrix Learning, founded by Brian Lee; the about page dates the launch to 2008. Company is in upstate New York (518 area code) but no city is published, so HQ omitted.

researched.description: FedHire talent acquisition and hiring management system for government agencies
researched.notes: Rebranded from Monster Government Solutions in 2025; monstergov.com now 301-redirects here. Current site is positioned almost entirely at federal agencies, which is a shift from the state workforce systems the MonsterGov name was known for - worth a look if the tracker is state-and-local only. Claims 24+ years but names no founding year, and no HQ address is published.

researched.description: AI identity verification, fraud detection and risk decisioning platform sold across banking, crypto, gaming, telecom and public sector
researched.notes: Horizontal identity platform; public sector is one of roughly ten named industries and the flagship references are large banks and card issuers. No HQ or founding year published on the site.

researched.description: Social media management, community engagement surveys and public-records archiving for government communications teams
researched.notes: Two things to flag. First, this is not the original MindMixer civic-engagement startup (that became mySidewalk); the name is now used by Social Assurance, which rebranded its 'Social Assurance for Government' line as MindMixer. Second, the parent also serves banking, financial services and education, so only the MindMixer line is government-specific. No founding year published.

researched.description: RTA Fleet360 fleet maintenance and asset management system for government fleets, school districts and transit agencies
researched.notes: HQ from the site's structured-data address; homepage states 'Est. 1979'.

researched.description: Enterprise secure browser and workspace control plane sold across healthcare, financial services, BPO, manufacturing, retail, government and education
researched.notes: Horizontal enterprise security product; government and education are two of eight named industries. No founding year published.

researched.description: Low-code process orchestration, RPA and AI automation platform for enterprises across financial services, insurance, life sciences and government
researched.notes: Horizontal low-code platform. Site claims 25+ years but gives no founding year, and no HQ address is exposed on the company or offices pages.

researched.description: Cloud contact center and AI customer experience platform sold across financial services, retail, healthcare, utilities and government
researched.notes: Horizontal CCaaS vendor; 'Government & Education' is one of nine named industries and the marquee logos are consumer brands. Founding year not confirmed from the company's own pages, so omitted.

researched.description: Network, cloud, endpoint and workspace cybersecurity products for enterprises and governments worldwide
researched.notes: General-purpose cybersecurity vendor; federal and state/local government is one of eight named industries. About page states 'a leader in cyber security since 1993' and lists Tel Aviv as international corporate HQ.

researched.description: Automated software testing and quality engineering platform for enterprise and public sector IT organizations
researched.notes: Horizontal test-automation tooling with a public sector landing page. Homepage blocked WebFetch with a header-overflow error; read via curl. No founding year published.

researched.description: Identity and access management, rostering and access governance for K-12 school districts and universities
researched.notes: Acquired by Jamf and now branded 'Identity Automation, a Jamf Company'; the contact page now lists Jamf's Minneapolis global HQ plus an Austin office, so the historic Houston HQ no longer applies. Healthcare is a third named vertical alongside K-12 and higher ed. No founding year published.

researched.description: E-Rate application, funding and compliance management software for schools, libraries and the vendors that serve them
researched.notes: Sells to both sides of the E-Rate program - school and library applicants, and the service providers, VARs and OEMs bidding on that funding. No HQ or founding year published; the phone number is a California 626 area code but that is not confirmation.

researched.description: AI math tutoring platform with a teacher dashboard for K-12 schools and districts
researched.notes: Legal entity is Learnie, Inc. dba Thinkverse. No founding year published. Category is the closest fit in the map; there is no K-12 instruction/curriculum category.

researched.description: AI service desk and service operations platform unifying IT, facilities, HR and transportation requests for K-12 districts
researched.notes: Candidate was listed as K12 Insight; k12insight.com now 308-redirects to onflo.com and the footer reads 'Onflo (formerly K12 Insight)', so the card should carry the new name. No founding year published.

researched.description: Web research, annotation and writing platform licensed by schools and districts for students and teachers
researched.notes: Also sold to individual professionals, but the school and district edition is the institutional business. No HQ or founding year published on the site.

researched.description: GURU site selection, property data and property tax mapping platform for economic development organizations and assessor offices
researched.notes: Built natively on Esri ArcGIS. Buyers are economic developers, site selectors and property tax offices; corporate site selectors such as Norfolk Southern are also clients. No HQ or founding year published - several staff are listed in Atlanta but the site never calls it a headquarters.

researched.description: Public benefits eligibility screening, enrollment and continuity platform covering Medicaid, SNAP, WIC and childcare subsidies for state agencies and health plans
researched.notes: Sells to state agencies alongside health plans, MCOs, providers and employers. Positioned around H.R.1 Medicaid community-engagement requirements taking effect in 2027. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Government operations platform combining shared workspaces, knowledge base, CRM and AI automation for public agencies
researched.notes: Public sector only; named practice areas are housing, public health, veteran services, emergency services and state administration. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Housing Choice Voucher, public housing and grants management software for public housing authorities
researched.notes: Homepage states the company has set the standard in PHA software 'since 1976'. Product line spans HCV/Section 8, LIPH, multifamily, payroll/HR, grants management and MyHousing portals. No HQ address published on the site or its contact page.

researched.description: Tenant screening reports, rental payment history exchange and debt collection services for affordable, conventional and student housing operators
researched.notes: A product line of ONLINE Information Services, Inc., which describes itself as having been in the collection business for almost 60 years. This is a consumer-reporting and collections service sold to property managers rather than a software product bought by government, so it reads as a supplier. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Property management and real estate accounting software spanning commercial, residential, senior living and affordable housing including PHA portfolios
researched.notes: Could not read yardi.com from this environment - every request, including through a rendered browser, was held at a Cloudflare bot-verification page, and the UK site redirects into the same block. Classification rests on the candidate record and the NAHRO context, not on the site; HQ and founding year deliberately omitted. Flagged for review both because the site could not be verified and because Yardi is a horizontal real estate platform where public housing is one of many portfolio types.

researched.description: Behavioral science hiring assessments and workforce analytics for behavioral health provider organizations
researched.notes: Site is a JS app read via a rendered browser session. Buyers are behavioral health employers - a publicly funded provider network rather than government agencies directly - so this is a soft govtech call. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Behavioral health EHR, human capital management and patient engagement software for CCBHCs and human services agencies
researched.notes: Three products: Welligent (EHR), DATIS e3 (HCM) and CaredFor (engagement). Customer base is community behavioral health, substance use treatment, child and family services and IDD programs - largely publicly funded providers. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Cloud EHR, telehealth, revenue cycle and population health software for physician practices and healthcare facilities
researched.notes: General ambulatory EHR serving 180,000+ physicians across all specialties, not a public-agency product - behavioral health is one specialty among many. Site gives no HQ address (the 508 phone number points to Massachusetts) and no founding year.

researched.description: Medicaid eligibility screening, benefits enrollment and social needs care management software for government agencies, FQHCs and payers
researched.notes: Registered as a Public Benefit Company; products are HealthBase, HealthWorks, MediKey and HealthEligible. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: AI analytics layer that queries across EHR, HR, payroll and outcomes data for community behavioral health agencies and CCBHCs
researched.notes: Candidate listed the product page (missiondrivendata.com/ai); the company is Mission Driven Data. Sells platform access rather than consulting engagements. No founding year published.

researched.description: Contract lifecycle management, policy and GRC software for health systems, hospitals, physician groups and FQHCs
researched.notes: Healthcare-vertical contract software; buyers are provider organizations and payers rather than public agencies, so flagged for owner review. Site claims 30+ years but names no founding year and gives no HQ address.

researched.description: Mira AI pre-assessment agent that runs intake and structured psychiatric assessments by phone or kiosk for behavioral health clinics
researched.notes: psyrin.ai 301-redirects to psyrin.com, which is the canonical site. Named users include the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, community mental health centers and crisis services. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Compliance management, staff training and HR operations platform for behavioral health programs
researched.notes: Claims 1,000+ behavioral health programs. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Quartex digital collections publishing platform and licensed primary-source archive databases for public and academic libraries
researched.notes: Exhibited under the product name AM Quartex; the company writes itself as AM and the legal entity is Adam Matthew Digital Limited (Pelham House, London Road, Marlborough, Wiltshire). About page states Adam Matthew was founded in 1990. Site 403s WebFetch; read via curl with a Chrome user agent.

researched.description: Atriuum cloud integrated library system and Booktracks asset tracking for public, school, academic and special libraries
researched.notes: Site claims over 35 years but names no founding year.

researched.description: Streaming arts and crafts class library sold as a consumer subscription and as a patron-access subscription to public libraries
researched.notes: Primary product is a direct-to-consumer craft class service - the site cross-promotes JOANN store discounts, reflecting its JOANN ownership - with libraries as a distribution channel, so it is content licensing rather than a government product. Site 403s WebFetch; read via curl. No HQ or founding year published; JOANN's 2025 bankruptcy means current ownership should be confirmed before the card is trusted on that point.

researched.description: Self-service fax and scan-to-email kiosks placed in public libraries, colleges and other public facilities
researched.notes: Operated by Televend Services, Inc. The offering is kiosk hardware plus a prepaid fax service, not software, so it lands as a supplier. Site dates the public library fax service to 1989.

researched.description: CASSIE public computer session management and SPOT print and hotspot management software for public and academic libraries
researched.notes: HQ from the contact page. No founding year published.

researched.description: Language learning platform in 70+ languages licensed by public libraries, school districts, universities and government agencies
researched.notes: Also sold direct to consumers and to businesses, but libraries are the lead named market and the institutional channel. The only address on the site is a Dublin GDPR representative, not a headquarters, so HQ is omitted; no founding year published.

researched.description: Staff training and patron education learning platform for public and academic libraries, municipalities and parks departments
researched.notes: About page states the company began in 2014 as a learning platform for libraries and has since added nonprofit, municipal and parks and recreation customers.

researched.description: Reading program and challenge management software for public libraries, schools and districts
researched.notes: Sold in three tiers - individual teacher, school/district, and public library. Also offered free to individual classroom teachers. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Subscription database of US state, county and local statistics compiled from more than 60 public and private sources
researched.notes: A general reference data platform sold by subscription to researchers and analysts, with libraries as one channel - not government-specific, so left for the owner. Two cautions: the about page returns HTTP 500, and the HQ comes from the site's structured data, which also carries an implausible 17,426-review aggregate rating and a Santa Monica PO Box ZIP, so the address is worth confirming before it goes on a card.

researched.description: Passwordless authentication and identity verification platform for workforce, customer and citizen identity
researched.notes: Horizontal identity platform; citizen identity is one of three named use cases and the flagship case study is a 450,000-user BPO deployment. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: AMSA Connect student data integration and S.A.F.E. admissions and financial aid fraud detection for colleges and universities
researched.notes: Higher education only; 50+ named institutional partners including Troy University and LSU. No founding year published.

researched.description: Email, network, application and data protection security products for businesses, MSPs, education and government
researched.notes: General-purpose cybersecurity vendor across six named industries. Founding year inferred from the site's own '© 2003 - 2026 Barracuda Networks, Inc.' copyright range rather than a stated founding date - drop it if that is too soft. No HQ address published.

researched.description: Ubuntu Linux, open source infrastructure and enterprise support subscriptions for enterprises and public sector IT
researched.notes: General open source platform vendor; public sector is one of several named segments. HQ from the contact page (3 More London Riverside). No founding year published. Candidate URL canonical.com is correct - www.canonical.com resolves to the same site.

researched.description: AI classroom engagement tool that runs live polls, transcribes lectures and generates study guides for university instructors
researched.notes: Early stage - the site says they are piloting with instructors and universities. Spun out of SOSO, an MIT-founded design studio, but no HQ address or founding year is published, so both are omitted.

researched.description: Endpoint, server and SaaS backup and recovery software for government, higher education, financial services and technology organizations
researched.notes: Horizontal backup product across seven named industries. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Lecture capture, video management, engagement and assessment platform for universities, colleges and schools
researched.notes: Education is the core market, with corporate training and government/military as secondary segments. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Argos reporting, FormFusion document automation and IntelleCheck payment software built for higher education administrative systems
researched.notes: Site states higher education has been the company's sole focus since founding, across 900+ institutions. Claims 25+ years but names no founding year, and no HQ address is published.

researched.description: Deep observability pipeline delivering network-derived telemetry to security and monitoring tools for enterprises and government
researched.notes: Horizontal network visibility infrastructure; federal and SLED are two of six named industries. No HQ or founding year published on the site.

researched.description: Anti-ransomware endpoint protection platform and 24/7 ransomware operations service for enterprises across ten industries
researched.notes: Horizontal security product; education and government are two of ten named industries and the marquee logos are Fortune 500 companies. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Research administration workflow software for internal funding, limited submissions, awards and review processes at universities
researched.notes: Serves 270+ institutions - research offices, graduate schools, provost offices and medical centers. No founding year published.

researched.description: Security awareness training, phishing simulation and email security platform for organizations in any industry
researched.notes: Horizontal security training vendor with 70,000 customers; education is one of several named verticals. HQ from the contact page. Site claims 15+ years but names no founding year.

researched.description: Modo Campus mobile app and portal platform unifying student services, wayfinding and campus systems for universities
researched.notes: Also sells Modo Workplace to Fortune 1000 enterprises (Northern Trust, Morgan Stanley), but the campus product and its university references - Penn State, Princeton, Notre Dame - are the core business. No founding year published.

researched.description: No-code governance, risk and compliance platform covering audit, policy, incident and third-party risk for enterprises and agencies
researched.notes: Horizontal GRC platform; named customers span insurance, healthcare, media and higher education. No founding year published.

researched.description: TotalView network performance monitoring and root-cause diagnostics software for enterprise and agency IT teams
researched.notes: Horizontal network monitoring tool. HTTPS on the apex host refused connections from this environment; reached over http://www.pathsolutions.com, and HQ came from the contact page. No founding year published.

researched.description: Vulnerability management, exposure management, cloud security, SIEM and managed detection and response for enterprises
researched.notes: Horizontal security vendor; named customers are banks, engineering, logistics, manufacturing and entertainment firms. The site references a Boston Bruins partnership but never states an HQ address, and gives no founding year, so both are omitted.

researched.description: AI classroom assistant giving teachers configurable student learning Spaces with a live progress dashboard for K-12 districts
researched.notes: Primarily K-12 teachers and district leaders, with some higher education use. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Direct-to-student study materials marketplace with one-on-one tutoring and career mentoring for US and UK university students
researched.notes: Candidate name SimpleStudyingAI Inc; the site brands as StudyCrowd.AI and its structured data still points at the earlier SimpleStudying property in London. Revenue today is student-paid: notes, model essays, tutoring hours and mentoring - a service, not an institutional product. There is a university pilot program advertised and an AI tutor (Clara) marked 'Coming Soon', so this could become an institutional sale later; worth revisiting. No founding year published.

researched.description: Adaptive learning and AI tutoring layer that plugs into a college's existing LMS to lift student engagement and reduce DFW rates
researched.notes: Sold to institutions rather than students - the buyer is the college, with the University of Birmingham as the named reference. Currently running a pilot program. Site 403s WebFetch; read via curl. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: PrinterLogic serverless print management and document workflow automation software for enterprises, healthcare, education and government
researched.notes: Formerly PrinterLogic; the exhibitor name Vasion Print is the print product line. Horizontal infrastructure software across 14,000 organizations - named customers are Carvana, Yahoo, NASCAR, Chick-fil-A and Nintendo. HQ confirmed on the company page. No founding year published.
